::: {#def-logits}

#### Logits

The **logits** of a classification network are the numbers its output layer computes for each class,
before the [softmax function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax) turns them into probabilities.
PyTorch's documentation uses this name.

The name comes from the logit function,
the [log odds](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-log-odds),
but most logits are not log odds.
Adding one number to every logit leaves the softmax unchanged,
so only their differences matter:
with two classes,
the difference $z_2 - z_1$ is the log odds of class 2.
Other names for logits are scores and unnormalized log probabilities.

:::
